plan.title: Material PR to RFQ Award and PO

steps.note: Provide the mandatory event title.
Set and commit the 30-minute event schedule.
Invite two QA vendors without inventing real supplier names.

args.goal: add exactly one Required T&C clause on the buyer's RFQ create screen, save it, and stop when the screen shows the clause has been added

steps.note: Perform the required T&C configuration, which has no dedicated catalog step.
Publish the configured RFQ event.
Verify publication reached a real project page.
Have Vendor A submit a quote of 100 through the vendor portal.
Verify Vendor A's quote was submitted.
Have Vendor B submit a quote of 90 through the vendor portal.
Verify Vendor B's quote was submitted.
Wait for the bidding window to end rather than force-closing it.
Open the buyer's comparison grid after bidding ends.
Assert that the lower bid ranks better, establishing Vendor B as Rank 1.
Directly assert Vendor B's column is Rank 1.
Award the entire available lot to the lowest vendor, Vendor B.
Verify the award proposal was created and submitted.

args.remark: Approved for the lowest evaluated bid.

steps.note: Approve the submitted proposal with the required remark.
Complete approval and create the purchase order(s).
Verify one PO contains exactly the awarded PR line.
Return to the events list to inspect the event's final history placement.
Open the History tab after the completed award flow.
Verify this plan's event appears in event history.
Assert the event has left Live and has a completed history status.
